interpretation.what_passed: The control-flow inversion is operationally consistent on already sealed mechanisms: exact basis admission can precede execution/transfer without changing their results, and unsupported cases can fail closed before expensive or unauthorized work.
interpretation.what_did_not_pass: No generic procedure was shown to derive the correct basis/surface from an arbitrary raw CNF without prior typed structure or provenance.
interpretation.anti_loop_lesson: The inversion is a successor repair of Trinity, not a brand-new mechanism. Trinity already implemented admission-before-execution for its old known doors; the repair extends that foundation to later sealed doors.
